the serrated chine: side step blocks with window slots, flank plates, belly plates, the sensor blister on the right flank
the dorsal trench with its spine and lights, deck lines, window rows, the hull plating patchwork in three tones, deck greebles and fittings
the stepped superstructure (Hull) and the bridge tower with its window band, two sensor dishes, two comm towers, masts
the APS emitter on the tower roof (Mount_APS)
four turbolaser turrets on the upper slopes
weak point: the two point-defence lasers forward, one shade off

the three drop-pod bays in the belly: ring, glowing pod and frame each
four landing legs folded under the belly (the running gear) with pads
